key_points: Two major downgrades (Wells Fargo, HSBC) within days, both citing YouTube-driven engagement erosion — a structural concern rather than a one-off miss.
Stock already down ~8.7%, so a meaningful portion of negativity is priced in, tempering further sharp near-term downside.
The central question — whether Netflix's viewer engagement is structurally declining versus YouTube — won't be resolved for 1-2 quarters of data.
Counter-narratives persist (BMO maintains Buy, bulls argue pullback is overdone) but are being overshadowed in the near term.
Sector landscape shifting with Paramount/WBD merger progressing adds competitive uncertainty.
